title: Systems and Methods for Federated Learning of Machine-Learned Models with Sampled Softmax

pse.problem: Inefficient resource usage in federated learning of machine-learned models
pse.solution_function: Sampling negative class labels locally and communicating them along with local positive class labels to a server. The server sends classification submodels to each client, which determine a model update based on sampled SoftMax loss using the local training dataset. The server aggregates model updates from clients.
pse.solution_structure: Client computing system: one or more computing devices, local training dataset, sampling mechanism. Server computing system: one or more computing devices, current version of machine-learned global classification model, communication channel.
pse.solution_implementation: Clients sample negative class labels and communicate client class sets to the server. The server sends classification submodels to clients, which use them with local training datasets to compute sampled SoftMax loss and determine model updates. The server aggregates model updates from all clients.
pse.effect: Reduced computing resource usage in federated learning of machine-learned models
